newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan CPC may sell China Petrochem stocks - paper.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan CPC may sell China Petrochem stocks - paper.

text.p: Taiwan monopoly Chinese Petroleum is preparing to sell its 145 million shares of China Petrochemical Corp, local media said on Thursday.
The Economic Daily News said the cabinet had approved Chinese Petroleum's selloff of its China Petrochemical stake.

Chinese Petroleum could begin selling immediately in the stock exchange, but the oil giant's president, Wenent Pan, said an evaluation of the views of the workers union and company strategy must come first, the newspaper said.
Company executives could not be reached for comment. After 70 minutes of trade, at 0210 GMT, China Petrochemical shares were trading at T$42.10, down T$1.30 compared to Wednesday's close.
Chinese Petroleum released 168 million shares of China Petrochemical in the 1997 fiscal years ending June 30, but still holds 145 million shares.
Once a state enterprise, China Petrochemical was transferred to private hands when a its state stake was sold down to 37 percent from 80 percent in June 1994.
